About the Bike Pensacola Slow Ride group ride

A monthly slow ride through Pensacola's historic neighborhoods that draws a few hundred people. Five or six miles in about an hour. Beginners, kids and cruisers are the norm. The start location moves; check Facebook.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
